component.name: TibiaVision-Linux
component.summary: BattlEye-safe screen-mirroring overlay for the Tibia Linux client

description.p: TibiaVision-Linux mirrors any region of the official native Tibia Linux client into floating, always-on-top windows you can place anywhere on your screen. Useful for keeping an eye on spell cooldowns, items, the battle list, or the minimap while you play.

The app is a pure screen-mirroring utility. It never reads game memory, never injects code into the Tibia process, never reads Tibia's files, and never touches the network. It uses only the standard XDG Desktop Portal ScreenCast and PipeWire APIs, i.e. the same pipeline OBS Studio and Discord screen share use.

ul.li: Multi-region screen mirroring with unlimited regions.
Per-region opacity, border glow, grid overlay, lock.
Profiles (save/load/import/export, cycle with a global hotkey).
Audio countdown timers with custom sounds and global hotkeys.
Dark theme, frameless mirror windows, always-on-top.

description.p: Initial alpha: portal capture, multi-region mirrors, profiles, audio timers, Flatpak packaging.
